title: Community Action Agency Closes Early for Thanksgiving
excerpt: The Webb County Community Action Agency closes at noon Wednesday, Nov. 25, and stays closed all day Thursday and Friday, Nov. 26–27, for Thanksgiving.
content:
The Webb County Community Action Agency will close at noon on Wednesday, Nov. 25, and stay closed all day Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, for Thanksgiving, the agency announced.

The agency wished residents and their families a happy Thanksgiving.

Sources: Webb County Community Action Agency, Nov. 25, 2026.
